questions.question: What was the median time from interconnection request to commercial operation for ERCOT projects that reached operation in 2025, in months?
questions.answer: The median time from interconnection request to operation for ERCOT projects in the 2025 row was 48.7 months (interconnection_durations_summary, variable median_months, a derived table). It covers 69 completed projects (same table, variable projects). The middle half of projects ran from 22.7 months (25th percentile) to 59.8 months (75th percentile) (same table). The 2025 row is the year label of the ERW's derived durations. It is built from Berkeley Lab's Queued Up file, which covers requests through 2025. I did not check the method note to confirm that the year refers to the year of commercial operation.

questions.question: What was the median time from interconnection request to commercial operation for CAISO projects that reached operation in 2024, in months?
questions.answer: Not in the warehouse. No table holds a request-to-operation duration for CAISO projects. The queue tables (caiso_interconnection_queue and lbnl_interconnection_queue) have a request date and an in-service date for each project. The query tool can't compute a per-project difference or its median, and I won't work one out by hand or estimate it. For scale only: caiso_interconnection_queue (source) has 15 completed projects with a status date in 2024 (its status_date, not necessarily the in-service date). lbnl_interconnection_queue (source, requests through 2025) has 15 CAISO-region projects operating, grouped by year (UTC), under 2024.

questions.question: Over the five years to 2025, what was the median time from interconnection request to commercial operation for PJM projects, in months?
questions.answer: For PJM projects that reached commercial operation in the five years to 2025, the median time from interconnection request to operation was 69.1 months (interconnection_durations_summary, variable median_months_5y, 2025 row, derived). It covers 241 completed projects (projects_5y, same table). The figures come from Berkeley Lab's Queued Up file, which covers requests through 2025. I took the 2025 row's five-year figure to be the window ending in 2025, and I did not check the method note for the exact window.
